The @DarkPoolFi_bot Telegram bot answers questions with public venue data and does not store your messages. If you turn on a settlement ping for an order, it keeps your Telegram chat ID, the window number and your language until the ping is sent, then deletes them; /stop deletes them sooner. A price alert keeps your chat ID, the market, the direction, the price and your language until it fires or you remove it. Subscribing to market updates keeps your chat ID and language until you unsubscribe or block the bot. It never receives your wallet, keys, orders, sides or sizes.
